meta.name: motion-graphics
meta.description: A short, design-led motion graphic where motion is the message — kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart/data-viz hit, logo sting / brand lockup, lower-third / callout / social overlay, animated map (highlight regions, connect places, zoom to a location), animated tweet / news-article / headline, webpage / UI animation (scroll, cursor, callouts), or fusing a real image's geometry into a chart. Usually under 10s (up to ~30s), no narration or live-action subject; renders to MP4 or transparent overlay. Longer / narrated / multi-scene → /general-video. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 制作短动态图形视频，如动效文字、数据动画或品牌标识
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要快速生成无旁白的动态图形视频
copy.tagline_en: Create short motion graphics like kinetic typography, data animations, or brand stings
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly produce short, narration-free motion graphic videos

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的描述自动生成短动画，比如文字动效、数字跳动、图表动画、地图动画等，输出 MP4 或透明视频。
howto.when: 当你要求制作一段简短、无旁白的动态图形（如片头、数据动画、地图高亮等）时触发。如果需求较长或有旁白，会转给其他技能。

say.text: 帮我做一个数字从0跳到1000的动画。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个统计数字跳动动画。

say.text: 给这段文字做一个动态排版效果。
把这条推文做成动画卡片。
say.note: Claude 会搜索推文并生成动画。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically generate short motion graphics based on your description, such as kinetic typography, stat count-up, chart animations, map animations, etc., outputting MP4 or transparent overlay.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a short, narrated motion graphic (e.g., intro, data animation, map highlight). For longer or narrated requests, it routes to other skills.

say_en.text: Create an animation where a number counts up from 0 to 1000.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a stat count-up animation.

say_en.text: Make a kinetic typography effect for this text.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a kinetic typography animation.

say_en.text: Animate this tweet as a card.
say_en.note: Claude will search the tweet and generate an animation.
